episodes.synopsis: Jumpei was fascinated by ballet as a boy but gave up on dancing to pursue Jeet Kune Do. One day, when he is in junior high, his classmate notices his interest and invites him to do ballet with her.
episodes.title: There's No Way I'm Doing That Ballet Thing!

episodes.synopsis: After watching a performance of Swan Lake with Miyako, Jumpei is inspired to try the pas de deux for himself. But when he sees Luou dance...
episodes.title: I Can't Be Friends with Someone Like Him!

episodes.synopsis: Luou finally starts coming to school, but he becomes the target of bullying. Meanwhile, Jumpei is trying to decide whether or not he will continue to dance amid all his other commitments.
episodes.title: What Does It Mean to Be Manly?

episodes.synopsis: Junpei finally takes a heavy load off himself by publicly admitting that he dances ballet. Now it only remains to prepare for the festival.
episodes.title: I Can Do Ballet Now

episodes.synopsis: Jumpei, Miyako, and Luou perform their version of Swan Lake at the ballet festival with the other students from the Godai Ballet Studio.
episodes.title: I Can't Die Now

episodes.synopsis: After the festival, Jumpei faces the consequences of his impromptu change to the choreography and ends up paying a visit to the Oikawa Ballet School with Luou.
episodes.title: Why Am I Doing Ballet?

episodes.synopsis: As Jumpei and Luou get used to the summer school class, they become involved in a friendly competition with some other boys from the class.
episodes.title: Ah, I'm So Embarrassed

episodes.synopsis: The boys are joined by girls from Miyako's SS class for pas de deux practice, and the other boys give Jumpei advice about how to interact with the girls.
episodes.title: Oh, I Wanna Do It Again!!

episodes.synopsis: As the summer school class comes to an end, Luou is reminded of his mother, and Jumpei must decide what path he will take in the next step of his ballet studies.
episodes.title: I Wanna Get Better, Too!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to look for Luou, Miyako tells Jumpei about her childhood with Luou and about Luou's relationship with their grandmother.
episodes.title: Miyako... You Need to Be by His Side

episodes.synopsis: Jumpei leaves Miyako and her family to take care of Luou and rushes back to Oikawa to perform on the last day of the boys summer school.
episodes.title: Oh, I Think I Love Classical Ballet
